accessibility: Uses real table semantics (thead/tbody/th with proper scope), so screen readers can announce row/column context for each cell.
Sortable column headers are real, keyboard-operable buttons that announce the current sort direction.

Per WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 4.1.3 (Status Messages), a sortable header sets aria-sort="ascending", aria-sort="descending" or aria-sort="none" and announces the change - a visual arrow icon alone is not sufficient.

source.notes: State, Appearance, Size and Corner radius are captured as crossed properties (State, Appearance, Size, Corner radius) - every combination draws as its own Figma variant. Show header is a bound Boolean property, with real geometry harvested by briefly showing the header row during export even if currently hidden. Row content stays illustrative reference content, not a configurable property. Native property IDs retain canonical values; anatomy styles and tokens use context.unit.
